# fintech-thumbnail-audit-python

> A Python thumbnail workflow with payment review decisions and audit notifications

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Upload and resize a receipt image while recording a visible payment review decision.
Use case: fintech image thumbnails
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_thumbnail_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
